name: Reality Shift
body:
School transmutation; Level occultist 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one willing creature; see text
Duration concentration + 1 round
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You concentrate on the target watching and subtly shifting the myriad of realities surrounding them. Once per round, as an immediate action, you may move the target of the spell up to 10 feet in any direction to a spot they are willing and able to occupy. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity and may be made only between resolved actions not in the middle of the resolution of an action. While you concentrate on this spell you may switch your focus to another willing target.
